phase: base lab environment; OIDC fixture with two issuers running

steps.action: Remove {name} on a provider row deletes its configuration at once, with no confirmation; accounts that signed in through it keep their rows and sign in another way
steps.expected: Row gone without a dialog; the other provider stays; SSO stays on; the Harbor staff row stays Active; a sign-in link still works for that account
steps.actual: Remove DOC-032 Harbor IdP removed the row at once with 0 confirmation dialogs; the card listed ["DOC-032 Helix IdP helix.example Configured"] and Legal SSO stayed true. The Harbor staff row stayed Active. With one provider left, Continue with single sign-on for the Harbor identity (by email: false) went to http://oidc:8080 and ended on /auth/login?error=sso with me 401 and "Single sign-on failed. Try again.". A sign-in link signed the same account in as legal_team_member.

steps.action: Removing the last provider turns off Single sign-on (SSO) under both Legal User Authentication and Business Portal Authentication; with another Legal method on, the staff sign-in page keeps it
steps.expected: Both SSO switches off and unavailable; stored sso false in both groups; staff page offers the password form
steps.actual: Before removal SSO was on in both groups ({"legal":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":true,"requireTwoFactor":false},"business":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":true,"requireTwoFactor":false}}). Remove DOC-032 Helix IdP (the last provider) left the card empty; both Single sign-on (SSO) switches read ["false:disabled","false:disabled"] and the stored policy was {"legal":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false},"business":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}}. The staff sign-in page offered the password form with buttons ["Sign in","Set up or reset your password","Email me a sign-in link"].

steps.action: If single sign-on was the only Legal method when the last provider is removed, the staff sign-in page shows the unavailable message and offers no Administrator sign-in link; recover from the still-open Administrator session
steps.expected: "Sign-in is unavailable. Contact your administrator."; no Administrator sign-in; Email and password turned back on from the live session
steps.actual: The first provider was registered again and Legal User Authentication set to SSO only ({"password":false,"magicLink":false,"sso":true,"requireTwoFactor":false}). Removing that last provider left Legal {"password":false,"magicLink":false,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}. A signed-out browser on the staff sign-in page read "Helix Software Group Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Sign in Sign-in is unavailable. Contact your administrator. Help wi" with buttons [], so no Administrator sign-in link. Daniel's open session turned Email and password ("Saved") and Email magic link back on ({"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}), and Nadia signed in with a password (me 200).
